input: Source recycled glass tiles for the kitchen backsplash

gold.taskTitle: Source Recycled Glass Tiles for Kitchen Backsplash
gold.taskDescription: Find and acquire recycled glass tiles suitable for installing as a kitchen backsplash.

questions.title: What is the total square footage to be tiled?
questions.description: Understanding the area helps determine quantity of tiles needed.

questions.title: Do you have a specific color palette in mind?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred colors narrows down tile selection significantly.

questions.title: What is your budget for the tiles themselves?
questions.description: Budget determines which suppliers and price tiers are realistic.

questions.title: What tile size or pattern are you aiming for?
questions.description: Size and layout pattern affect sourcing, cutting, and quantity calculations.

questions.title: Do you need the tiles by a specific date?
questions.description: A deadline affects whether local pickup or shipping is viable.

questions.title: Are you open to purchasing online, or local only?
questions.description: Purchase preference determines which sourcing channels to prioritize.

questions.title: Will you install yourself or hire a professional?
questions.description: Installation method may influence the tile finish, thickness, or format required.
